text_block_list.text:
Training ended, and as I was cleaning up 
together with Biwa Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Taishin! Are you cleaning up after 
training too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Just taking a break. I'm gonna keep at 
it a bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Are you serious? It's already night. 
Resting to prepare for tomorrow is also an 
important—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Leave me alone. I know what I'm 
doing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... As a friend—and as your 
rival, how could I just let you push 
yourself like that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I'm worried about her. May I 
go join her for training?
choice_data_list:
If they're your rival, you should believe 
in them

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I'm worried about her. May I 
go join her for training?
choice_data_list:
If they're your rival, you should believe 
in them

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I owe you one.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Train together...? I thought you said 
you were done for the day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run made me crave a run of my 
own. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... honestly, good grief. Even when I 
tell you not to, you always tag along 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't blame me if you still feel tired 
later.

And so, extra training continued right up 
until the brink of curfew.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...! 'If they're rivals'... huh.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...There's no holding hands across the 
finish line. That is the true, serious 
duel we seek.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then what I should do right now is head 
home and soothe this exhaustion..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To face her efforts with everything I've 
got, in top condition... That's the plan!

Watching her rival's back as she walked 
away, Biwa Hayahide headed back to the 
dorms.
